visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed light-blue gradient banner with an eyebrow line, a large headline, and a decorative IV/drip-bag image at the right. Not a full-cover hero — the image is a side decoration over the gradient.
contentPattern: 1 column, up to 2 rows: an optional decorative image row and a heading row (eyebrow paragraph, heading, optional subheading).
usage: Page-intro sub-banner combining a headline with a decorative side image over a gradient background.
